No row carries trailing punctuation in either source. instructions = the P.9 stem verbatim, '¿Está Ud. muy de acuerdo, bastante, poco o nada de acuerdo con las siguientes afirmaciones?' (asserted as a substring of the questionnaire text in .cache/spain_2012_gender_beliefs/write_items.R); 'P.9' number dropped; no interviewer direction and no show card for P.9 (tarjetas2968.pdf covers P.4, 5, 11, 14, 15, 25, 31, 32, 38, 40 only). All four substantive codes are read out; no '(NO LEER)' code, no N.P./0 code (asked of all: 0 zeros in DA). RESP: CIS codes stored unchanged, 1 = Muy de acuerdo ... 4 = Nada de acuerdo, so higher = LESS agreement.
